Revitalize and repair your skin with Cosrx Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence. Enriched with 96% snail mucin, this lightweight essence deeply hydrates, soothes irritation, and supports skin regeneration for a healthy, glowing complexion.

Made in: Korea

Benefits: Deep hydration, skin repair, soothing, and regeneration
